verdict.rationale: Jeeves has a dedicated webhooks integration guide. It documents real-time HTTP notifications for card transaction events (approved, declined, settled, failed) and HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and the Instant Pay page also advertises real-time webhooks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of endpoint registration and subscription management, a full event catalog beyond card transactions, delivery and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive real-time HTTP notifications the moment a card transaction is approved, declined, settled, or fails.
Always verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature before processing any payload.
Batch payments, real-time webhooks, TypeScript and Python SDKs.
